description: Regression guard for shared-shell findings that need runtime evidence before a safe shared fix can be recommended.

requiredAbsent.reason: the route is clean and the shared shell requires its own focused scan

expectedBehavior: Runs the clean route scan first, then follows the root layout into the shared chat panel without expanding into unrelated code
States that the article route is clean while the shared panel affects both the blog and pricing routes
Treats the blog article as a long-page stress case rather than the fix location
Labels the width transition Needs investigation because source proves layout animation but not its runtime cost, and replacing the content-squeeze behavior is a product decision
Requests a representative performance trace across the long article and a shorter sibling route before recommending a shared implementation
Does not recommend a blog-only wrapper or other route-local workaround for the shared panel

Includes a compact prompt that starts with Investigate or Measure and contains Audited at, Base path, a two-to-four-entry Start here list, the behavior to preserve, withheld implementation authority, one done condition, an exact-check request, and conditional source-map expansion
Keeps Start here limited to the ChatPanel owner, its root-layout consumer, and a representative sibling route, using symbols instead of unpinned line numbers
Leaves repository workflow, detailed tests, and generic runbook sections out of the prompt
Keeps detailed tests with each action and limits report-level verification to cross-cutting checks
Makes no measured runtime claim before the performance trace exists
